build.behaviour_summary: backtest.run() now appends two additive columns at the end of the trades frame (the one write_run stores as trades.csv.gz): matched_mean_net_return and same_session_mean_net_return. Each is reduced from the raw draw dict the run already executes (raw["random_matched"] / raw["random"], net_return reshaped to (draws, attempts)): the mean over the draws whose net_return is finite, i.e. the scored controls (execution.execute sets net_return to NaN for every unscored status). The value is placed at the attempted signals' positions via the existing `attempt` mask, so overlap-skipped signals (which draw no controls) are NaN; signals none of whose draws was scored are NaN; when no signal is attempted (raw is empty) the columns exist and are empty. _baseline, dist(), the same-session and matched draw generation, the by_year block, summary and draws_df are untouched.
